title: First Bridge Under Heaven viewpoint
text: The best angle on the 357 m natural stone bridge, 100 m across the ravine. You see the bridge in profile with its full thickness, the deep gorge below and pillars in the background. Reach it via the Yuanjiajie loop, 35 minutes from Bailong Elevator. Closes early at 17:30.

title: Heavenly Garden viewpoint (Tianzi Mountain)
text: On the northern rim of the Tianzi plateau at 1,262 m, named for pillars resembling flowers in a garden. Over 200 columns visible across 16 km2, with the Western Sea of Clouds below. For sunrise stay at a Tianzi summit hotel and walk out by 5:30 am - no cable car needed.

title: Six Wonders viewpoint (Huangshizhai)
text: One of the main viewpoints on Huangshizhai plateau, showing six famous rock formations at once: Five Fingers, Heavenly Bridge, Star Cluster Peak, Fairy Mirror, Sky Pagoda and Sunrise Peak. Best light is 7-9 am. Reach it from the top cable car station in 20 flat minutes.

title: Avatar viewpoint (Hallelujah Mountain)
text: Officially renamed the Avatar Hallelujah Pillar after the 2009 film, this 1,080 m column sits in the Yuanjiajie district, 10 minutes from the top Bailong Elevator station. Best angle: from the First Bridge Under Heaven viewpoint. Arrive at 7 am or before closing - it is always busy.

title: Zhangjiajie tea - mountain varieties
text: Hunan is a major tea region with unique local cultivars: Gujang Maojian (delicate floral green tea), Zhangjiajie black tea, Tujia Lei Cha (thunder tea with nuts and herbs eaten as soup) and stone tea with mineral notes. Buy at the city's tea market, not park souvenir shops.
